persian_edits.before: همچنین، «الْجَلَاءَ» در حشر ۵۹:۳ به بیرون رفتن از سرزمین اشاره دارد و نباید تنها به سبب اشتراک ریشه، به روشن شدن یا تجلی ترجمه شود.
persian_edits.after: همچنین، «الْجَلَاءَ» در حشر ۵۹:۳ به بیرون رفتن از سرزمین اشاره دارد و نباید تنها به سبب اشتراک ریشه، به روشن شدن یا تجلی ترجمه شود. **معنای کوتاه ریشه: آشکار شدن، آشکار ساختن و برطرف شدن پوشیدگی؛ در کاربرد سرزمین، بیرون رفتن و ترک جایگاه پیشین.**

persian_edits.before: > الْجِيمُ وَاللَّامُ وَالْحَرْفُ الْمُعْتَلُّ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ، وَقِيَاسٌ مُطَّرِدٌ، وَهُوَ انْكِشَافُ الشَّيْءِ وَبُرُوزُهُ.
persian_edits.after: الْجِيمُ وَاللَّامُ وَالْحَرْفُ الْمُعْتَلُّ أَصْلٌ وَاحِدٌ، وَقِيَاسٌ مُطَّرِدٌ، وَهُوَ انْكِشَافُ الشَّيْءِ وَبُرُوزُهُ.

evidence.use: Five occurrences in five verses across four surahs:7:143:25,7:187:12,59:3:6,91:3:3,92:2:3. Two Form II verbs,two Form V verbs,and one noun.All61 assigned lexical roots audited at exact QAC positions.
Primary Maqayis:inkishaf and buruz;polishing,bride presentation,clear sky,territorial departure,and poetic witnesses.

Primary Lisan:transitive and intransitive jala/ajla,disclosure,polishing,bride usages,departing,and Abu Dhuayb bees/smoke witness with ijtalaha and tahayyarat variants. Retained supplied Arabic but made variant note more precise.
Primary Mukhtar Sihah and Lisan:vowel-sensitive jalaa/jilaa,transitive/intransitive uses,polishing,bride terms,and weak forms.
Primary Tabaqat Fuhul al-Shuara explicitly attributes Ana ibnu Jala to Suhaym ibn Wathil.Preserved historical caution rather than assigning a definite pre-Islamic composition date.
Primary Sharh Qatr al-Nada discusses multiple Ibnu Jala analyses.Marked supplied free Persian rendering as interpretive rather than literal.
Primary Lisan A Y M gives iyam as smoke or the smoking implement used to drive bees away.Supports supplied kasrah reading;no forced quotation correction.

Primary Hamasat al-Khalidiyyayn attributes the tabaddat sun/cloud poem to Qays ibn al-Khatim. It is explicitly a semantic comparison from another root,not a direct J L W witness.Softened unverified claim of authoritative diwan wording to transmitted wording.
Primary Qurtubi gives tajalla as zahara and records command/power interpretation.Preserved distinction between lexical manifestation,seeing request,mountain consequence,and later theological claims.
Primary Tabari discusses hidden knowledge of the Hour and sudden arrival.Kept disclosure distinct from time and suddenness.

Primary Tabari explains jalaa as territorial departure and connects it to the particular historical event.Preserved difference from general travel and avoided generalizing expulsion to religious groups.

Primary Tabari includes the sun/day interpretation and darkness-pronoun alternative.Kept pronoun interpretation separate from jallaha lexical meaning.Refined physical explanation:no claim that night darkness physically hides the sun.

Expanded Al Hashr59:2–5 into four individually written verified references in both languages.All edited lexical boxes complete;existing contexts,canonical Allah boxes,translations,protected reflections,and prior work preserved.

Compared nine complete Persian verse translations and five excerpts against installed text.Five of14 match;all differing renderings marked proposals rather than current Forqan text.No installed translations changed.

Verified primary Maqayis on inkishaf and buruz,and primary Lisan/Mukhtar Sihah on disclosure,polishing,bride usages,clear sky,territorial departure,and transitive/intransitive jala/ajla.Preserved vowel-sensitive jalaa/jilaa distinctions and the need to examine waw/ya weak-root forms individually.Kept J L W distinct from J L L majesty.

Refined the day/sun explanation:removed the suggestion that night darkness physically prevents the sun being seen.Replaced it with observer-based association as the sun rises,explicitly distinguishing poetic attribution from a physical causal mechanism.Clarified that7:187 concerns the Hour itself being disclosed at its time,rather than reducing disclosure to announcing a date.

Primary Tabaqat Fuhul al-Shuara attributes Ana ibnu Jala to Suhaym ibn Wathil.Primary Sharh Qatr al-Nada discusses alternate analyses.Marked the supplied free Persian rendering as interpretive rather than literal.Preserved original attribution and caution over exact composition date.

Primary Lisan supports the Abu Dhuayb bees/smoke witness,including ijtalaha and tahayyarat variants.Made the variant note explicit without changing supplied Arabic.Primary Lisan A Y M supports iyam as smoke or a smoking implement,so retained supplied kasrah vocalization.Primary Hamasat al-Khalidiyyayn supports Qays ibn al-Khatim attribution;kept this as a semantic comparison using another root rather than a direct J L W witness.Softened an unverified authoritative-diwan claim to transmitted wording.

Preserved the distinctions between manifestation,the request for sight,the mountain’s crushing,and Moses’s collapse.Primary Qurtubi records both appearance and command/power readings.Explicitly avoided presupposing that manifestation establishes a bodily form.Kept theological conclusions separate from the lexical verb and retained differing pronoun readings for91:3,documented in primary Tabari.
